ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in quadrilateral $ABCD$, points $M$ and $N$ are located on $AB$ and $BC$, respectively. Triangle $\triangle BMN$ is folded along $MN$ to obtain $\triangle FMN$. If $MF\parallel AD$ and $FN\parallel DC$, what is the measure of $\angle B$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\[
\text{Solution: Since } MF \parallel AD, \text{ and } FN \parallel DC,
\]
\[
\therefore \angle FMB = \angle A = 110^\circ, \angle FNB = \angle C = 90^\circ,
\]
\[
\text{Since } \triangle FMN \text{ and } \triangle BMN \text{ are symmetric about } MN,
\]
\[
\therefore \angle BMN = \angle FMN = 55^\circ, \angle BNM = \angle FNM = 45^\circ,
\]
\[
\therefore \angle B = 180^\circ - \angle BMN - \angle BNM = \boxed{80^\circ}.
\]
